authmod.configuration.title: UnderMine Auth
authmod.configuration.kickOnExpiredToken: Disconnect when the token is expired
authmod.configuration.disconnectWhenInva: Disconnect when the API rejects the token
authmod.configuration.notifyOnJoin: Show token status in chat on join
authmod.configuration.bindTokenToPlayer: Require the token to belong to the player
authmod.auth.title: UnderMine account
authmod.auth.fill_fields: Enter a username and a password.
authmod.auth.launcher_session: An external session token is active; it has priority over the in-game login.
authmod.auth.signed_out_external: In-game session cleared; an external token is still active.
authmod.auth.hint: Used for servers with the UnderMine Auth mod. The launcher token has priority and the account name must match the player name.
authmod.auth.reminder.chat.login: You are not authenticated. Sign in with /log <password>.
authmod.auth.reminder.chat.register: You are not authenticated. Create an account with /reg <password> <password>. Already have an account? Use /log <password>.
authmod.auth.command.waiting: Signed in as %s. The server is verifying the token...
authmod.auth.command.registered: Account created and signed in as %s. The server is verifying the token...
authmod.auth.command.saved_reconnect: Signed in as %s. Reconnect to the server to authenticate.
authmod.auth.command.login_failed_hint: Authentication failed: %s. If you do not have an account yet, use /reg <password> <password>.
authmod.auth.command.register_exists: This account already exists. Use /log <password> to sign in.
authmod.auth.command.too_fast: Please wait a moment before trying again.
authmod.auth.too_fast: Too many attempts, wait a moment.
authmod.auth.session_lost: The secure session is gone. Reconnect to the server and try again.
message.authmod.no_token: UnderMine: this session was not launched by the UnderMine launcher (no bearer token). Sign in from the UnderMine account screen or with /log <password>.
message.authmod.token_malformed: UnderMine: the bearer token is malformed, please sign in again.
message.authmod.token_expired: UnderMine: your token expired at %s. Please sign in again.
message.authmod.token_invalid: UnderMine: the authorization server rejected your token (%s). Please sign in again.
message.authmod.validation_unavailable: UnderMine: the token could not be validated (%s).
message.authmod.join_validated: UnderMine: token accepted for %s, valid until %s.
message.authmod.server_no_token: UnderMine: no authorization token was provided. Use /log <password> or /reg <password> <password>.
message.authmod.server_token_malformed: UnderMine: the authorization token is malformed. Use /log <password> or /reg <password> <password>.
message.authmod.server_token_expired: UnderMine: your authorization token expired at %s. Use /log <password> to sign in again.
message.authmod.server_token_invalid: UnderMine: the server rejected your authorization token (%s). Use /log <password> to sign in again.
message.authmod.server_validation_unavai: UnderMine: the server could not validate your token (%s). Try again later.
message.authmod.server_token_mismatch: UnderMine: this token belongs to the account %s, but the game is logged in as %s.
message.authmod.server_handshake_failed: UnderMine: the secure authorization handshake failed. Restart the game and try again.
message.authmod.server_client_missing_mo: UnderMine: this server requires the UnderMine Auth mod. Launch the game through the UnderMine launcher.
message.authmod.auth_timeout: UnderMine: you did not authenticate within %s seconds. Reconnect and use /log <password> or /reg <password> <password>.
